About the Company
An major Financial institution is looking for a skilled Frontend Engineer to help deliver modern, user-focused digital experiences to millions of customers. This 12-month contract role is based in Sydney, with preference for attendance in the paramatta office offers flexible hybrid working, with the chance to work on high-impact features in a modern tech stack.
About the Role
You'll join a cross-functional agile team to build and enhance responsive, accessible, and secure web applications.
Develop responsive frontends using React, TypeScript and modern frameworks
Integrate with GraphQL APIs and backend microservices
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
Work closely with UX designers and backend engineers to deliver seamless user experiences
Contribute to design discussions, sprint planning, and code reviews
Maintain high standards for accessibility, performance, and security
About You
We're seeking a frontend specialist who thrives in fast-paced, agile environments and cares deeply about user experience and code quality.
Strong commercial experience in React and TypeScript
Proficient with GraphQL, REST APIs and frontend testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library)
Experience working in enterprise or financial services environments is a plus
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and agile delivery methodologies
Understanding of accessibility, performance optimisation, and secure coding practices
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with teams
Fullstack capabilities with Java on the backend is preferential
Must have full Australian working rights, and be on-shore in Australia.
The Benefits
Initial 12 month contract with strong scope for extension
Hybrid working with 2-3 days per week in office (at least 1 day in Paramatta)
Work within a highly collaborative team
How to Apply
Please apply with current resume in Microsoft Word format only (.doc or .docx). We are currently recieving extremely high volumes of applications. One of our team will seek to give you an outcome as soon as possible. Your patience is appreciated. If you have any additional questions, please reach out to Nina Magill, quoting reference JN -082025-40997. Want to know more about Davidson? Visit us at www.davidsonwp.com
Don’t provide your bank or credit card details when applying for jobs.
